headline: More than 5,000 subscribers in Bishkek will be left without electricity due to debts
summary: More than 5,400 electricity subscribers in Bishkek with outstanding debts for consumed power face a planned remote disconnection on November 24.
why: Unpaid utility bills reflect collection problems in the electricity sector, which affects utility revenues and public finances in Kyrgyzstan.
original_headline: В Бишкеке более 5 тысяч абонентов останутся без света из-за долгов
